condition-desk.kicker: For housebuilders and land promoters after planning permission
trust: 38 conditions on a 150-home outline permission in Albrighton
46 conditions on a 586-home scheme in New Malden
condition-desk.chart_caption: 11 of 38 conditions must be cleared before work can start on site.
before_after: Every condition worked through by hand after permission is granted
A register of every condition in plain English, usually within a day
Slow to see what must be approved before work can start
The conditions that block a start on site are picked out for you
Guessing which specialist to commission
Each condition shows which specialist usually prepares it and which documents to gather
Drafting each submission letter from scratch
A drafted covering letter to the council for each submission
step_texts: Send us the decision notice. That is the whole brief.
Every condition is put into plain English: what the council needs, when it is due, which specialist usually prepares it and which documents to gather.
You get the register with the conditions that block a start picked out, plus a drafted covering letter for each council submission. You or your planner send each submission to the council.

extra_faq.q: Do you submit anything to the council?
extra_faq.a: No. Condition Desk does not give planning advice and does not submit anything to the council; you or your planner remain responsible.

habitat-draft.kicker: For ecology consultancies, before the site visit
trust: Built on real current applications, including a 98-home site at Romsey
Protected sites and priority habitats within 600 metres
Tree and hedge heights from the Environment Agency's laser survey
habitat-draft.chart_title: How sure the national data is, parcel by parcel
habitat-draft.chart_caption: Low-confidence parcels are where your walkover time matters most. The desk study does not score habitat condition; the ecologist does that on site.
before_after: Hours per site gathering maps and records: protected sites, priority habitats, the national habitat map, tree heights, aerial photos
One two-page desk study, usually within a day
Arriving on site to work out which parcels need attention
A prioritised list of parcels to check on the walkover
Staff stretched in survey season doing desk work
The desk work is done before the visit
No starting figure for baseline biodiversity units
A rough first draft of baseline units to correct on site, never a finished baseline
step_texts: Send us a site boundary or a planning reference.
We pull together protected sites and priority habitats within 600 metres, a first habitat map from national data, and tree and hedge heights from the Environment Agency's laser survey.
Usually within a day you receive a two-page desk study with a prioritised list of parcels to check on the walkover. The ecologist signs everything.

bid-check.kicker: For firms that bid for public contracts
trust: Worked on real live tenders, including Hedge End Town Council's Drummond Community Centre refurbishment
52 requirements found in that tender: 18 pass-or-fail, 18 documents, 12 scored criteria
In testing it agreed with a person's own reading on 19 of 24 requirements
bid-check.chart_title: What is in the Drummond tender pack
bid-check.chart_caption: Miss one pass-or-fail item and the bid is lost. Each requirement is quoted from the tender with its source.
before_after: Reading every public tender pack end to end by hand takes days
A bid at a glance, usually within a day
Missing one pass-or-fail item loses the bid
Every pass-or-fail condition listed, quoted from the tender
Bid writers charge around £500 a day
£600 per tender, or £1,500 a month for up to three
Matching requirements to your certificates, policies and past projects by hand
Your evidence checked against each requirement, the gaps listed, first-draft answers written
step_texts: Send us the tender pack, and if you like your library of certificates, policies and case studies.
Every pass-or-fail condition, document, scoring rule and key date is listed and quoted from the tender, then your evidence is checked against each requirement.
You get a list of gaps to close and first-draft answers. Your team signs off every answer.

extra_faq.q: Do you submit the bid or guarantee a win?
extra_faq.a: No. Bid Check does not submit bids or guarantee a win; your team signs off every answer.
